artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $q_p(2)=(2^{p-1}-1)/p$ denote the Fermat quotient of $2$ modulo $p$, let $\left(\tfrac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol, and let $E_n$ denote the Euler numbers (defined by $\operatorname{sech} x=\sum_{n\ge 0} E_n x^n/n!$). Determine whether all of the following congruences hold:

(i) $\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{p-1}\frac{1}{k\,2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv -3p\,q_p(2)^{2}\pmod{p^{2}}.$

(ii) $\displaystyle p\sum_{k=1}^{p-1}\frac{1}{k\,2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv \begin{cases} 0\pmod{p^{2}} & \text{if }p\equiv 1\pmod 4,\\[2pt] -3/5\pmod{p^{2}} & \text{if }p\equiv 3\pmod 4. \end{cases}$

(iii) For $p>3$, $\displaystyle p\sum_{k=1}^{p-1}\frac{1}{k^{2}\,2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv -\frac{q_p(2)}{2}-\frac{p}{4}\,q_p(2)^{2}\pmod{p^{2}}.$

(iv) $\displaystyle \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{25k+3}{k\,2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv 6\!\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)-18p\pmod{p^{2}}.$

(v) $\displaystyle p\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{25k-3}{2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv \!\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)-\!\left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)\frac{5p}{2}\pmod{p^{2}}.$

(vi) $\displaystyle 2p\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{25k-3}{2^{k}\binom{3k}{k}}\equiv 3\!\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)+(E_{p-3}-9)p^{2}\pmod{p^{4}}.$

Prove or disprove the conjunction of (i)–(vi).
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published proof or refutation of this particular package of six supercongruences (Conjecture A54 from Z.-W. Sun's list of open conjectures on congruences). Many of Sun's binomial-coefficient supercongruences have been proved over the past decade, but no specific source verifying all parts (i)–(vi) was located, so the status remains unclear.
